title: Outside contribution: review and squash-merge the stacked natural-sort PRs #604 -> #605 -> #606 (DEC-181; issue #603)
description: DEC-181 (quest-cli, first case). Three open PRs from the fork Aztec03hub (Phil LaFayette), all base dev, all fixing the same id-ordering defect, stacked and overlapping on src/domain/tasks/tasks.ts and test/task-id-natural-sort.test.ts: #604 https://github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli/pull/604 closes issue #603 https://github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli/issues/603 (order task ids by number; +146/-21, 7 files); #605 https://github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli/pull/605 (draft and cleanup ids by number; +229/-25, 8 files); #606 https://github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli/pull/606 (a milestone task ids in numeric order; +213/-23, 9 files). Measured 2026-10-13: all three are MERGEABLE and BLOCKED only by held workflow runs -- GitHub holds the workflow runs of a first-time contributor, so no check has reported. maintainerCanModify is true on all three. Ruled by opum-doc DEC-181: (2) read the WHOLE diff and confirm it touches no .github/, package.json scripts or dependencies, lockfile, build or test-runner config, or install hooks before approving any run; (4) squash-merge with credit, never re-implement and close; (5) technical-only comments with a fixed disclosure line; (7) handle #604 first, then #605 and #606 in stack order. A separate sonnet reviewer runs the whole-diff check by ref; this session never checks out or runs fork code locally. The contributor never needs to touch .quest.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The three PRs are handled in stack order #604 then #605 then #606, and each is acknowledged on the PR within one working day.

Before any held workflow run is approved for a PR, the whole diff of that PR is confirmed to touch no .github/, no package.json scripts or dependencies, no lockfile, no build or test-runner configuration, and no install hooks; a PR touching any of those goes to opum-doc without approving runs.
Each PR is squash-merged, preserving the contributor authorship on the commit, only once its required check set is green on that exact head SHA and the reviewer has approved that same head SHA.
No fork code is checked out or run on a fleet machine outside CI.
Every comment posted on a PR is technical only and ends with the line: Reviewed by an AI agent working for the Opum maintainers.
Each PR outcome (merged, or changes requested) is reported to opum-agent, and the contributor is never asked to edit .quest.
